176-3899-4875.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-3899-4875.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

751-3499-4289.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

997-3175-8207.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

116-512-2691.easyPrerequisites: Ilysian Caryatid and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-2691.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
116-512-2691.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Ilysian Caryatid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-4976--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-4976--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

3899-6249-7256--5.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy kicked by paying {2}{B}{R}, creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Warhost's Frenzy's delayed ability trigger.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1497-5220-6900-7492.description:
Cast Wild Cantor by paying its mana cost.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

670-1619-4142-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-4142-6153.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying its mana cost.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, causing Vicious Battlerager to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Hostage Taker trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Hostage Taker.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7509.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gleeful Arsonist
When Gleeful Arsonist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
5686-6972-7509.notes: If Gleeful Arsonist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

240-969-2292-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

719-6291-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Xenograft, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat step 3.
719-6291-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

2033-3713-4311-5078.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

527-1409-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5963-6568-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
5963-6568-7009.description:
Activate Marvin using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Marvin.
Repeat each turn.

1778-2173-2829-5220.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1350-2793-2921-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

339-677-2034-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
339-677-2034-4068.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1651-2073-2829-6757--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the noncreature artifact enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the noncreature artifact returned in step 1 and the Munitions token, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the noncreature artifact.
Repeat.
1651-2073-2829-6757--90.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions to get infinite damage if desired. If the noncreature artifact chosen can sacrifice itself without tapping or additional costs, you can omit the sacrifice outlet, but will forego the possibility of infinite damage.

997-1445-4871-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
997-1445-4871-5632.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2724-3335-3987.notablePrerequisites: Lady Sun does not have summoning sickness.
2724-3335-3987.description:
During your precombat main phase, cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

4050-4871-5010-5572.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {1}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.
If desired, you may instead use Golgari Thug's dredge ability to return it to your hand to mill your library.

2281-2757-4786-5237.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Saffi, untapping the basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Renegade Rallier, untapping the basic land.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier.
Activate Claws of Gix by paying {1} and sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Claws of Gix ability, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

579-2544-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding six {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

1734-2885-4344-4605.description:
Cast Rescue the Foal by paying {1}{W}, blinking Lumbering Battlement and exiling Rescue the Foal.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Fiend Hunter until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning any cards exiled with it to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a copy of Lumbering Battlement that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Lumbering Battlement until the token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
The nontoken Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, choose not to exile a creature.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling the token Lumbering Battlement.
The token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Lumbering Battlement from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

232-455-3593.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Priest of Urabrask from your hand onto the battlefield.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Hoverguard Sweepers from your hand onto the battlefield.
Hoverguard Sweepers enters the battlefield, returning itself and Priest of Urabrask from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1931-3613-4050-4999.description:
Cast Wild Dogs from your graveyard by paying {G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wild Dogs, adding {G}.
Wild Dogs is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Dress Down removing Wild Dogs's cycling ability.
Repeat.

1722-3284-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Korvold, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on it and drawing you a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

539-1247-3430.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
539-1247-3430.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
